rules._note: GPG signing not enabled by default. Enable separately if/when operator wants signed-tranche policy. Left false here to match the develop baseline and the tranche-3 precedent.

Pull-request reviews are explicitly NOT required on tranche/2-7 -- slices push directly per operator decision 2026-07-12. The promotion PR (tranche/2-7 -> develop) is governed by the develop-side ruleset, not this one.

required_status_checks._note: Primary push-time gate on tranche/2-7. Mirrors the tranche-3 ci: cargo test + npm typecheck + npm test. The .github/workflows/tranche-2-7-ci.yml file (parallel to tranche-3-ci.yml) has not been authored yet; until it exists, this check is enforced as 'no-op pending workflow' and should be created before tranche/2-7 is dispatchable. The operator owns the workflow authoring.

Manifest + release-notes validator. Fires from the tranche-2-7 ci workflow (no path filter). Runs tools/release/check_release_manifest.py against any touched manifest.yaml or release-notes.md under programs/codex/requirements/... . The .github/workflows/tranche-2-7-ci.yml file (parallel to tranche-3-ci.yml) has not been authored yet; this is contingent on the workflow existing first.

rules._note: Restrict pushes to a list of actor ids. Operators should fill in their actual maintainer github user ids here. Names/slack handles are documentation; the API requires numeric ids.
Branch exists already; creation blocked is irrelevant until the branch is deleted/recreated.
If the operator wants to allow specific actors to bypass the rules above (e.g. an autofix workflow bot), populate push_actors in the restrict_pushes rule and/or add them here. By default no bypass.
